frames.visible_job: Draw the left post with its pointed cap, connected top rail, light wood grain, and a small base grass mark.
frames.instruction: Draw a tall left post with a pointed cap and light vertical grain. From its upper third, pull a level top rail rightward with a little grain, leaving its far end open. Mark a small grass tuft at the post base.

frames.visible_job: Join the matching right post and bottom rail, with light wood grain and a small right base grass mark.
frames.instruction: At the top rail's open end, draw a matching right post. Link the posts with one lower horizontal rail and lightly grain both. Mark a small grass tuft at the right base.

frames.visible_job: Place exactly three evenly spaced slats inside the frame and one diagonal brace behind them.
frames.instruction: Divide the space between the rails into three upright slats. Draw one diagonal brace from the lower left toward the upper right, stopping where boards cover it.

frames.visible_job: Add two hinges on the left post and a simple latch at the upper right.
frames.instruction: Place one iron hinge beside each rail on the left post. At the top rail's right end, draw one short latch over the right post.

frames.visible_job: Set three uneven path stones, enlarge the two established grass tufts, and add a broken ground shadow.
frames.instruction: Draw three flattened stones below the bottom rail. Enlarge the small grass tuft at each outer post base, then add a short broken shadow beneath the gate.

final_step.visible_job: Deepen established contours and add restrained brown-gray colored pencil over the existing gate, hardware, stones, grass, and shadow.
final_step.instruction: Strengthen selected graphite edges; shade the established rails, posts, and slats with pale warm brown, the hinges and latch cool gray, and the stones and grass lightly. Leave paper gaps for weathered wood.
adds: graphite shading and restrained color on established regions

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop establishes a tall pointed left post and one attached level top rail. Their corner fixes the height and width of the future gate; light grain and a small left-base grass mark are already visible and now taught in Step 1.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I inspected the full 3x2 contact sheet and all five adjacent saved-JPG pairs. Both post bases and the rail heights remain fixed; the three slats and diagonal brace keep their overlap order, hardware remains aligned to the rails, and the path stones, grass, and shadow persist through the colored finish. No temporary guides appear or require removal.

transitions.observed_addition: The left post and its top rail stay at the same height and width. A matching right post attaches at the open rail end, a bottom rail closes the frame, and a small right-base grass mark appears.
transitions.instruction_match: The second instruction names the right-post attachment, lower connecting rail, light grain, and right grass; those are the visible additions.

transitions.observed_addition: Both posts and rails retain their corners. Exactly three slats fill separate positions between the rails, while one brace rises from lower left to upper right behind their faces with clean stopped overlaps.
transitions.instruction_match: The third instruction asks for three uprights and a rear brace; the image shows that count and the brace remains behind the boards.

transitions.observed_addition: The three slats and rear brace keep the same attachments. One hinge arrives at the upper left rail and a second at the lower left rail; one horizontal latch reaches the right post at the upper rail.
transitions.instruction_match: The fourth instruction places two hinges at rail heights and one right latch. No board or brace needs to move to fit them.

transitions.observed_addition: Gate, brace, both hinges, and latch remain fixed. Three flattened stones appear in a receding stack below the lower rail; both existing base grass tufts grow outward and a short broken shadow grounds them.
transitions.instruction_match: The fifth instruction calls for the three stones, fuller grass from existing marks, and a shadow. The image makes those additions without covering the gate.

transitions.observed_addition: All two posts, two rails, three slats, rear brace, two hinges, latch, three stones, both grass tufts, and broken shadow remain at the same anchors. Warm brown touches existing wood; gray and green shade existing stone, iron, and grass.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction adds restrained color and selected graphite value to established marks. The last saved crop introduces no new contour or prop.
